title: KR integrated alpha portfolio v1 prospective decision receipt
description: One immutable, append-only record per future decision date, written BEFORE any outcome exists. Built and validated by pipeline/kr_integrated_alpha_portfolio_receipts.py. A receipt carries every input identity, the industry membership used, the registered feature values, the three scores, the eligible names, both underlying books, the C0 and C1 states and multipliers and ALL SIX target portfolios; it contains no future quantity. Receipts are evaluated only after their horizon matures on the KR calendar; no historical row is ever rewritten. Prospective evidence is the only route to validation for this architecture; every historical number is development evidence.

codeIdentity.description: commit SHA plus SHA-256 of every file in the frozen dependency closure that produced the receipt

signalDate.description: the KR session whose close every signal is computed at

executionDate.description: the next KR session; targets apply from its close

createdAtUtc.description: wall-clock time the receipt was written; must precede the execution-session close

inputIdentities.description: SHA-256 of every input snapshot read (prices and caps, PIT accounting, industry membership, market sources)

industryMembership.description: ticker -> frozen 14-group industry (null when unclassified) as used on this date

stockFeatures.description: ticker -> the registered stock features (bookToMarketProxy, earningsYieldProxy, negativeDownsideVol126); null when missing

industryFeatures.description: industry -> REL_MOM_126 and BREADTH_ABOVE_MA_126; null when missing

scores.description: ticker -> STOCK_SCORE, INDUSTRY_SCORE, COMBINED_SCORE (null when missing)

eligible.description: tickers eligible for the S book and for the I+S book

underlying.description: selected names and base weights BEFORE any market scaling

market.description: per candidate: layer states, multiplier in {1.0, 0.7, 0.4} and whether it was held for a missing state

targets.description: all six target portfolios, derived as underlying x multiplier; at most five names, no leverage

developmentDecision.description: the sealed development architecture decision (or its no-decision outcome) this ledger was opened under; all six targets are recorded either way

receiptSha256.description: SHA-256 of the canonical JSON of every other field
